name: Sukuna's Fingers
description: (Tag:spirit)(Tag:tool)All 20 fingers of Ryomen Sukuna, the King of Curses, each containing 1/20th of his power and radiating incredible cursed energy that attracts cursed lifeforms. A cursed being ingesting a finger gains a power boost, while a proper vessel will either incarnate as 1/20th Sukuna, share the vessel with him, or defeat his fragment and consume its power.
